query: I just tried the new matcha croissant from the bakery down the street this morning, it was so flaky and the matcha filling wasn’t too sweet at all, I ended up buying two more to take home for my roommate. Oh and my cat figured out how to open the snack cabinet last night, he dragged a whole bag of tuna treats under the couch and ate almost half of it before I caught him. I’ve also been binging this new historical drama lately, the costumes are so detailed I keep pausing just to look at the embroidery on all the formal outfits. Anyway, I’m currently abroad and my data mode is switched off, I have roaming turned off too and I prefer not to use the bad network connection here, but my mobile internet won’t work at all right now, can you help me figure out what’s going on?
